title: Vote on adding the draft bitmap spec to git
summary: These are the final messages of the vote on adding a draft bitmap spec to git; the message that opened the vote and described the change is not among them. All five replies here are +1 votes: two marked binding (Fokko and Szehon), two marked non-binding (Steve and Huaxin), and one from Prashant Singh, who said he was in favor of getting started with the draft and thanked Ryan. No concerns or objections were raised in these messages. Ryan Blue then closed the vote on June 9, 2026, announcing that it passed with 13 +1 votes, 9 of them binding, and no -1 or +0 votes. The messages here do not describe what the draft spec contains.

positions.stance: In favor of getting started with the draft.

outcome.note: Passed with 13 +1 votes, 9 of them binding, and no -1 or +0 votes.
